text: Ascension's own site describes it as 'One of the nation's leading non-profit, faith-based health systems'; since 2011 it has been guided by a single Vatican-approved Ascension Sponsor, a Ministerial Public Juridic Person made up of religious and lay members.

source.name: Ascension: History & Religious Sponsorship
source.quote: In 2011, the Vatican approved the creation of a single Ascension Sponsor, a Ministerial Public Juridic Person. Today, the Ascension Sponsor is made up of both religious and lay members
source.note: Page updated since the previous check (2026-09-26): it now reads '36 states' and no longer carries the earlier '2,600 sites of care in 16 states' wording. The timeline on the same page reads 'Today: One of the nation's leading non-profit, faith-based health systems, serving communities across 36 states and the District of Columbia.'
